stories.title: Bessent's bond market moves fail to stop yield surge
new_facts: Introduces $32tn Treasury market fight, Bessent strategy to buy more long-term debt, and Wall Street 'band-aid on a bullet hole' criticism.
Treasury sanctions 15 people in Ecuador-to-US cocaine trafficking network using fishing vessels and power boats.
Adds JPMorgan's James Sullivan and his quote comparing bond intervention to paying a mortgage with a credit card.
Reports interest rates rebounded Thursday despite Bessent's efforts, showing the intervention hasn't worked.
New Iran-sanctions story: Bessent pledges 'toughest sanctions in history' and calls oil price spike 'noise'.
Bessent says new sanctions will collapse the Iranian government and urges China's support.
Adds new figure: total US debt reaches $40 trillion, amid Bessent's bond-market balancing act.
Reports Treasury yields hit 20-year highs, with Washington Post's David Lynch discussing causes and impacts.
stories.line: Treasury Secretary Bessent is trying to stabilize surging bond yields with market interventions that critics say are unsustainable.

stories.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil organizers under national security law
new_facts: First report of guilty verdict; includes quote from activist group calling judicial system 'twisted'.
States three activists (not two) were accused of inciting subversion of state power.
Names defendants Lee Cheuk-yan (69) and Chow Hang-tung (41), leaders of Hong Kong Alliance, and cites the 2020 national security law and incitement charge wording.
Unrelated new story: Shanghai's Star 50 index up nearly 25% this year, outperforming Hong Kong amid tech rally.
stories.line: Hong Kong court convicts two organizers of annual Tiananmen Square vigils under national security law, further restricting public commemoration of 1989.

stories.title: Trump reconciles with former fixer Michael Cohen on air
new_facts: Trump says Cohen was 'weaponized' by mainstream media during the interview.
Confirms Trump and Cohen actually reconciled and spoke publicly on Thursday, completing the previously anticipated interview.
Cohen's 2019 congressional testimony called Trump a racist, conman, cheat and mobster; interview was a call-in to 77 WABC radio.
Only a 15-minute snippet aired Thursday; full interview airs in entirety on WABC Sunday.
Interview covered substantive topics including Iran and the economy, not just personal reconciliation.
Cohen once called himself Trump's 'attack dog with a law license' and previously used the term 'predator' for Trump.
Trump claimed in the interview he would win by 25 points if he ran for a third term.
stories.line: Trump and Michael Cohen, formerly antagonistic, conducted a friendly radio interview; Trump blamed media for weaponizing Cohen against him.

stories.line: Democrat Aisha Wahab won a California House special election to replace Eric Swalwell, who faced sexual assault allegations.

stories.title: Panama Canal cuts daily transits as drought tightens
new_facts: Panama Canal Authority to cut daily transits due to El Niño-driven drought, only second such cut ever.
Specific transit cuts: 36 to 34 ships/day from Sept 3, then to 32 from Sept 15.
stories.line: Panama Canal will reduce daily ship transits due to drought caused by El Niño, threatening a critical global trade chokepoint.
